incorporated_articles.title: 9. Create a secure service which protects users’ privacy
11. Choose the right tools and technology

units.text: The Service Standard helps teams to create and run great public services.
units.text_start: helps teams to create and run great public services

units.text: Develop a deep understanding of users and the problem you’re trying to solve for them. Focusing on the user and the problem — rather than a particular solution — often means that you learn unexpected things about their needs.
units.text_start: Develop a deep understanding of users and the problem

units.section: 9. Create a secure service which protects users’ privacy
units.text: Service teams must follow the Secure By Design principles and: ensure senior leaders who are accountable for security are aware of risks; have a plan and budget to manage security during the life of the service; perform due diligence on the security of third-party software; collect, process and store data securely and in a way which respects users’ privacy; maintain an assessment of security risks and mitigate threats with appropriate protections.
units.text_start: Service teams must follow the Secure By Design principles

units.section: 11. Choose the right tools and technology
units.text: When considering technology choices, service teams should understand how the technology they use works, including emerging technologies and artificial intelligence (AI).
units.text_start: understand how the technology they use works
units.text_end: including emerging technologies and artificial intelligence (AI)

units.section: 11. Choose the right tools and technology
units.text: Service teams should consider how the technology will impact user experience and inclusion — for example, avoid situations where your technology choices might reduce the reliability of information given to users or decisions made about them.
units.text_start: consider how the technology will impact user experience and inclusion
units.text_end: reliability of information given to users or decisions made about them

units.section: 11. Choose the right tools and technology
units.text: Understand total cost of ownership of the technology and preserve the ability to make different choices in future — for example, reducing the chances of getting locked into contracts for specific tools and suppliers by using open standards.
units.text_start: preserve the ability to make different choices in future
